name: Gesamtkunstwerk
subcategory: 'total artwork' making use of many or all art forms
summary: A Gesamtkunstwerk (German: [ɡəˈzamtˌkʊnstvɛʁk] , 'total work of art', 'ideal work of art', 'universal artwork', 'synthesis of the arts', 'comprehensive artwork', or 'all-embracing art form') is a work of art that makes use of all or many art forms or strives to do so.
description: A Gesamtkunstwerk (German: [ɡəˈzamtˌkʊnstvɛʁk] , 'total work of art', 'ideal work of art', 'universal artwork', 'synthesis of the arts', 'comprehensive artwork', or 'all-embracing art form') is a work of art that makes use of all or many art forms or strives to do so. The term is a German loanword accepted in English as a term in aesthetics.
